description: Scrape Houzz professionals by market, city, profession or keyword, enrich profiles with reviews and contact details, or browse photo inspiration by room and style.

categorySlug.description: Exact Houzz category slug, used instead of the mapped profession, e.g. `general-contractor`, `architekten`, `architectes`. Use a direct directory URL if you are unsure.
categorySlug.title: Category slug override

city.description: City or city + state to search, e.g. `Los Angeles, CA`, `London`, `Berlin`. Used with profession or categorySlug in search mode.
city.title: City

country.description: Houzz market used for search and profile URLs.
country.title: Country

directoryUrls.description: Houzz professional directory, category or search-result URLs. All live markets and localised paths are accepted.
directoryUrls.title: Directory URLs

enrichEmails.description: Best-effort email lookup on each professional's own website. Adds requests and is optional.
enrichEmails.title: Enrich contact emails

fetchDetails.description: Open each professional profile for services, awards, socials, counts and licensing. Turn off for directory-card-only records.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full profiles

fetchPhotoDetails.description: Open each photo for full image sizes, owner, location and question count.
fetchPhotoDetails.title: Fetch photo details

includeReviews.description: Attach review history to each professional record.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

keyword.description: Optional keyword filter for professional search, or the search term for photo mode.
keyword.title: Keyword

maxPages.description: Optional page cap. Set 0 to use the source ceiling: 100 directory pages, 30 keyword pages, 250 photo pages or 10 photo keyword pages.
maxPages.title: Max pages

maxReviewsPerPro.description: Review cap per professional. Set 0 to fetch the full history (up to 1,024).
maxReviewsPerPro.title: Max reviews per professional

minRating.description: Drop professionals below this star rating. Set 0 to keep all.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviewCount.description: Drop professionals with fewer reviews. Set 0 to keep all.
minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count

mode.description: What to scrape. `search` builds a directory from country + city + profession; `byUrls` reads directory URLs; `profiles` reads profile URLs; `reviews` emits review rows; `photos` browses photo inspiration.
mode.title: Mode

photoCategory.description: Room category for photo inspiration browsing. Use keyword to search instead.
photoCategory.title: Photo room

photoStyle.description: Optional design style filter for photo inspiration.
photoStyle.title: Photo style

photoUrls.description: Direct Houzz photo detail URLs. Use mode=photos.
photoUrls.title: Photo URLs

profession.description: Universal profession mapped to the selected market's Houzz category. Used in search mode.
profession.title: Profession

profileUrls.description: Direct Houzz professional profile URLs, including localised paths such as /experten/, /professionnels/ and /profesionales/.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs

sortBy.description: Server-side order for professional directory results.
sortBy.title: Sort professionals by

title: Houzz Scraper Input
